Scenes depicting the birth of Sankara will be so modified as to establish that when Sankara was born, his father Sivaguru was alive. For this purpose, new footage will be added. This will show that just prior to the confinement of Aryamba, Sivaguru went to the nearby forest for collecting sacrificial firewood, where he gets unwell, in his absence, Aryamba has labour pains and as shown in the film divine assistance is bestowed for successful confinement, A new scene will be introduced where Aryamba shows the new born baby to Sivaguru. The scenes depicting the death of Sivaguru will be shown after the scene depicted in Reel No. 3, shot 18.
